items.title: Review: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
items.summary: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

items.title: Review: Multiple people shot at 'large' party in California, sheriff's office says
items.summary: Officials said a call about a shooting in Strathmore came in at about 7:40 p.m.

items.title: Review: Wash. officials condemn ICE after 2 arrested boarding flight at Seattle airport
items.summary: Plainclothes officers in masks detained two people who were boarding a flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport.

items.title: Review: Now Is Not the Time for Europe to Relax
items.summary: It’s easy to hope that our good old post-1945 Uncle Sam, holding his security umbrella over European and Asian allies, is back again. He isn’t.

items.title: Review: China’s Spies Set Sights on A.I. Chips Years Before Nvidia Scandal
items.summary: China’s espionage agency has been running a secret campaign to help the country’s companies acquire advanced A.I. chips and to gather intelligence on the sector, officials say.

items.title: Review: Mercury gets its first visitor in years as a pair of spacecraft loop into orbit
items.summary: The European Space Agency announced BepiColombo's arrival via social media.

items.title: Review: Deadly Protests Erupt in Bangladesh Over Exiled Former Leader. What to Know.
items.summary: Supporters of the deposed prime minister, Sheikh Hasina, who was sentenced to death in absentia, have waged a small-scale insurgency to destabilize the current government.

items.title: Review: China Investigates CNPC Deputy General Manager for Corruption
items.summary: Xie Jun, a deputy general manager at China National Petroleum Corp., is under investigation for suspected “serious violations” of discipline and law, the nation’s top anti-graft authority said in a statement on Sunday.

items.title: Review: FBI's national crime database targeted in hack, Trump says
items.summary: President Donald Trump confirmed on Saturday that the FBI’s National Crime Information Center database was targeted in a hack.

items.title: Review: Australian Opposition Calls for Changes to Gas Reservation Plan
items.summary: Australia’s opposition coalition party has raised more concerns about the government’s plan for liquefied natural gas exporters to increase supply to the domestic market, ahead of the legislation being voted on this week.
